name: hedera-lending-market
description: Collateralized lending market on Hedera: supply and borrow an HTS stable asset against HBAR collateral, with Pyth-powered pricing, SaucerSwap liquidation swaps, and an HCS activity feed.

envVars.description: Funded Hedera TESTNET account ID (0.0.N); deployment only.
ECDSA private key for that account (raw or DER hex). Never commit.
Optional testnet JSON-RPC endpoint; default https://testnet.hashio.io/api.
Optional Hermes base URL for bootstrap; default https://hermes.pyth.network.
Hermes Bearer API key for bootstrap; configure separately in packages/nextjs/.env.local for the app.

steps.text: The app boots without credentials. Read README.md for testnet deployment, server-only Pyth/HCS settings, and current SaucerSwap testnet limitations.
